headline: Small caps Turn Lower by Lunch

writeup.headline: Small caps Turn Lower by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Health Insurers Slide as Humana, CVS, UnitedHealth Fall. The big swing: small caps rallied early, then turned around after 9:46 AM and are now lower on the day — Quantisnow points to “Citigroup (C): Citi sets 17-month Russell 2000 buffer notes, 25.80% max return”. The AI names are down and the average stock is down: stocks are moving together. Defensive sectors are leading cyclical ones, and the S&P has stayed under pressure.

themes.headline: Small caps flipped from up to down
